files.description: Plate 40 x 40 x 20 with a through bore r = 5 on the z axis; nothing near the bore.
Blind bore r = 5 from z = 8 to the top face (planar disk bottom).
Through bore r = 5 beside a rectangular pocket whose inner plane sits at x = 5 + 1: a wall of thickness 1 mm between pocket and bore.
Through bore r = 5 beside a rectangular pocket whose inner plane sits at x = 5 + 1e-2: a wall of thickness 1e-2 mm between pocket and bore.

Through bore r = 5 beside a rectangular pocket whose inner plane sits at x = 5 + 1e-7: a wall of thickness 1e-7 mm between pocket and bore.
Through bore r = 5 beside a parallel through hole r = 2 whose surface is 1 mm from the bore surface.
Through bore r = 5 beside a parallel through hole r = 2 whose surface is 1e-2 mm from the bore surface.
Through bore r = 5 beside a parallel through hole r = 2 whose surface is 1e-4 mm from the bore surface.
Through bore r = 5 beside a parallel through hole r = 2 whose surface is 1e-6 mm from the bore surface.
Through bore r = 5 beside a parallel through hole r = 2 whose surface is 1e-7 mm from the bore surface.
Through bore r = 5 with a coaxial counterbore R = 8 from z = 15 (bore band 0..15, mouth annulus at 15).
Beam on posts above the plate with a pin r = 1 hanging into the bore to z = 10, its surface 1 mm from the bore wall (a true obstruction).
